title_sq: Dupleks 3+1+3 ne shitje te Residenza Kodra e Diellit 1 (ID 4131349).

title_en: Duplex 3+1+3 for sale in Residenza Kodra e Diellit 1 (ID 4131349).
description_en: At Residenza Kodra e Diellit 1, duplex 3+1+3 for sale, new building, 1st floor, mortgage, new modern furniture. The apartment has an area of ​​172 m², is organized in a spacious living room, kitchen with separate cooking area, 3 bedrooms, corridor, 3 bathrooms, 2 balconies, LED lighting, multisplit air conditioning system with air conditioning in each room.
